title: P1 fix: exclude the acting session from bee worktree new's concurrency check
action: Fixes review finding #1 (P1, session worktree-concurrency-guard-review-20260724): handleWorktreeNew (canonical: skills/bee-hive/templates/bee.mjs, ~line 3877) calls `hasAnySharedNestedCheckout(mainRoot)` with NO options, so isConcurrentMode has no excludeSessionId and can count the ACTING session's own live heartbeat as 'another' session -- a false-positive refusal for a genuinely solo agent, violating D6 and the feature's own 'OTHER session' definition. Fix: resolve the acting session id the same way this file already does elsewhere (resolveSessionId({ root: mainRoot }), already imported in bee.mjs -- see existing call sites at lines ~441, ~1103, ~1333) and pass it through: `hasAnySharedNestedCheckout(mainRoot, { excludeSessionId: sessionId })`, mirroring exactly how bee-write-guard.mjs already calls guards.isSharedNestedCheckoutTarget(root, cand.abs, { excludeSessionId: sessionId }). Propagate the canonical edit via the established regen chain (render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs + onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, repo-scoped, no --global-skills) exactly as wcg-1/wcg-2/wcg-3 did. Prove red-first: a test where the ONLY live session record matches the acting session's own id (simulate by writing a session record whose id matches what resolveSessionId would resolve for that invocation) currently refuses `worktree new` even with zero real concurrency; after the fix it succeeds.

truths: A checkout whose ONLY live session record is the acting session's own (no genuine second session) allows `bee worktree new` to proceed even when a companion-eligible nested checkout is present
A checkout with a genuine SECOND live session still refuses exactly as before (no regression on the real defense)

artifacts.substantive: handleWorktreeNew resolves and passes excludeSessionId to hasAnySharedNestedCheckout, mirroring the write-guard's existing self-exclusion pattern
new red-before/green-after test row(s) covering both the self-only case (proceeds) and the genuine-second-session case (still refuses)

key_links: handleWorktreeNew resolves its own session id and threads it into hasAnySharedNestedCheckout's opts
prohibitions: Do not weaken the refusal for a genuine second live session -- self-exclusion only, never disabling the check entirely

Do not change guards.mjs's hasAnySharedNestedCheckout signature in an incompatible way -- it already accepts opts and forwards to isConcurrentMode(root, opts), this fix only needs to PASS excludeSessionId at the call site

regen_obligation_ack: release_manifest.mjs --check stays dropped from verify for the same pre-existing, already-filed, unrelated file-mode-drift reason recorded on wcg-1/wcg-2/wcg-3 (2026-07-23 friction). The action still runs release_manifest.mjs --write for real content-hash regen of the touched files, surgically limited to actually-changed entries.

trace.outcome: handleWorktreeNew now resolves the acting session id (resolveSessionId({root:mainRoot})) and passes { excludeSessionId } into hasAnySharedNestedCheckout, so a genuinely solo agent's own live heartbeat no longer trips a false-positive WORKTREE_CONCURRENT_SHARED_NESTED refusal (P1, review finding #1). A real second live session still refuses exactly as before — self-exclusion only, never disabling the check. Canonical skills/bee-hive/templates/bee.mjs edit propagated via render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs + onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply to all 6 bee.mjs copies (byte-identical, same md5); release-manifest content-hashes regen'd surgically (5 sha256 entries, mode-drift noise excluded per ack).
